verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a sandbox or test mode that keeps testing away from production data. The Zapier Partner Sandbox is a separate workspace for partners maintaining an integration, and the docs explicitly say it is "not an API test mode or isolated data environment for API consumers." The API playground sends live requests to the production server at api.zapier.com, so it is not sandbox isolation either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
